summary.short: Mexico's private-sector data protection law. Private controllers and processors must observe principles, obtain consent, issue privacy notices, secure data and honour ARCO rights. Supervised by the Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno, with sanctions and crimes. In force from the day after its DOF publication of 20 March 2025.
summary.long: Mexico's private-sector data protection law governs personal data processing by private natural and legal persons nationwide (Arts. 1, 2). It excludes credit reporting companies and purely personal, non-commercial collection (Art. 1). Controllers must follow principles of lawfulness, purpose, consent, proportionality and accountability, with express consent for financial and sensitive data (Arts. 5-13). They must issue privacy notices, keep security measures, report significant breaches and designate a person to handle requests (Arts. 14-19, 29). Data subjects hold ARCO rights, including objection to solely automated processing that significantly affects them (Arts. 21-26). Transfers, domestic or foreign, are governed by Arts. 35-36; binding self-regulation schemes are permitted (Art. 37). The Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno supervises compliance and resolves rights-protection and verification procedures (Arts. 38-57). Fines range from 100 to 320,000 times the UMA, with an additional fine for repeated breaches and up to doubling for sensitive data (Art. 59). Imprisonment of three months to five years applies to specified data-misuse offences (Arts. 62-64); civil damages claims are preserved (Arts. 53, 61). Transitory provisions move the former INAI's data protection functions to the Secretaría.

notes: Text coverage: the document is the Decree of 20 March 2025 as consolidated to DOF 14-11-2025. Articles Primero, Segundo and Cuarto of the Decree are shown only as placeholders (……). Annotation covers Article Tercero (this law), the Decree's transitorios, and the appended transitorios of the 14 Nov 2025 reform decree (Art. Trigésimo Octavo). Text inconsistencies: (1) Art. 2 XV names the Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno, while Transitorio Quinto names it Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno y Transparencia para el Pueblo. (2) Transitorio Segundo II repeals the 2015 Ley General de Transparencia y Acceso a la Información Pública, while Transitorio Tercero refers to Arts. 71-72 of a law with the same title; the text does not separate the two. (3) Art. 4 was reformed on 14-11-2025 but the reformed wording is not reproduced. Private persons (sujetos regulados, Art. 2 XVI) are the general addressees and are not listed as entities.

Aviso de Privacidad: Documento a disposición de la persona titular de la información de forma física, electrónica o en cualquier otro formato generado por el responsable
Bases de datos: Conjunto ordenado de datos personales referentes a una persona identificada o identificable condicionados a criterios determinados
Bloqueo: Identificación y conservación de datos personales una vez cumplida la finalidad para la cual fueron recabados
Consentimiento: Manifestación de la voluntad libre, específica e informada de la persona titular de los datos mediante la cual se efectúa el tratamiento de los mismos
Datos personales: Cualquier información concerniente a una persona identificada o identificable

Datos personales sensibles: Aquellos datos personales que afecten a la esfera más íntima de la persona titular, o cuya utilización indebida pueda dar origen a discriminación o conlleve un riesgo grave para esta
Derechos ARCO: Derechos de acceso, rectificación, cancelación y oposición al tratamiento de datos personales

Disociación: Procedimiento mediante el cual los datos personales no pueden asociarse a la persona titular ni permitir, por su estructura, contenido o grado de desagregación, la identificación de la misma
Fuente de acceso público: Aquellas bases de datos, sistemas o archivos que por disposición de ley puedan ser consultadas públicamente cuando no exista impedimento por una norma limitativa
Persona encargada: Persona física o jurídica que sola o conjuntamente con otras trate datos personales por cuenta del responsable
Responsable: Sujetos regulados a que se refiere la fracción XVI de este artículo
Secretaría: Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno
Sujetos regulados: Personas físicas o morales de carácter privado que llevan a cabo el tratamiento de datos personales
Tercero: Persona física o moral, nacional o extranjera, distinta de la persona titular o del responsable de los datos
Titular: Persona a quien corresponden los datos personales
Tratamiento: Cualquier operación o conjunto de operaciones efectuadas mediante procedimientos manuales o automatizados aplicados a los datos personales
Transferencia: Toda comunicación de datos personales dentro o fuera del territorio mexicano, realizada a persona distinta de la titular, del responsable o de la persona encargada del tratamiento

obligations.summary: Controller must observe the principles of lawfulness, purpose, loyalty, consent, quality, proportionality, information and accountability in processing personal data.

obligations.summary: Controller shall not obtain or process personal data by deceptive or fraudulent means; data must be collected and processed lawfully and the reasonable privacy expectation protected.

evidence.quote: El responsable no deberá obtener y tratar datos personales a través de medios engañosos o fraudulentos

obligations.summary: All processing of personal data requires the data subject's consent, subject to legal exceptions; financial or patrimonial data require express consent; controller must set out in the privacy notice how consent can be revoked.

evidence.quote: procurará que los datos personales contenidos en las bases de datos sean exactos

obligations.summary: Processing must be limited to the purposes in the privacy notice; for a different purpose, controller must obtain consent again from the data subject.
obligations.conditional_on: Processing for a purpose other than those in the privacy notice

evidence.quote: se requerirá obtener nuevamente el consentimiento de la persona titular

obligations.summary: Processing must be necessary, adequate and relevant to the purposes in the privacy notice; for sensitive data, controller must make reasonable efforts to limit the processing period to the minimum indispensable.
obligations.conditional_on: Sensitive personal data for the period limit

evidence.quote: el responsable deberá realizar esfuerzos razonables para limitar el periodo de tratamiento de los mismos

obligations.summary: Controller must adopt the necessary and sufficient measures to apply the data protection principles and to ensure the privacy notice is respected by it and by third parties with which it has a legal relationship.

evidence.quote: debiendo adoptar las medidas necesarias y suficientes para su aplicación

obligations.summary: Controller must inform the data subject, through the privacy notice, of the existence and main characteristics of the processing of their personal data.

evidence.quote: El responsable tendrá la obligación de informar a la persona titular, a través del aviso de privacidad

obligations.summary: Privacy notice must contain at least: identity and address of controller; data processed (identifying sensitive data); purposes (distinguishing those requiring consent); options to limit use or disclosure; ARCO mechanisms; and the procedure for notifying changes.

evidence.quote: El aviso de privacidad deberá contener, al menos, la siguiente información

obligations.summary: Privacy notice must be made available in the form suited to the collection: at the time of collection for printed formats; for electronic collection, a simplified notice with items I to IV of Art. 15 and a link to the full notice.

evidence.quote: El responsable debe poner a disposición de las personas titulares el aviso de privacidad

obligations.summary: Where data were not obtained directly from the data subject, controller must notify them of the change in the privacy notice; the duty does not apply to historical, statistical or scientific purposes, and compensatory measures are allowed where direct notice is impossible or disproportionate.
obligations.conditional_on: Data not obtained directly from the data subject; excluding historical, statistical or scientific purposes

evidence.quote: el responsable deberá darle a conocer el cambio en el aviso de privacidad

obligations.summary: Controller must establish and maintain administrative, technical and physical security measures to protect personal data against damage, loss, alteration, destruction or unauthorised use, access or processing; minimum level is that used for its own information.

evidence.quote: Todo responsable deberá establecer y mantener medidas de seguridad administrativas, técnicas y físicas

obligations.summary: Security breaches at any stage of processing that significantly affect the data subject's property or moral rights must be reported to the data subject immediately.
obligations.conditional_on: Breaches that significantly affect patrimonial or moral rights of the data subject

evidence.quote: le serán informadas de forma inmediata por el responsable

obligations.summary: Controller or third party must establish controls or mechanisms so that all persons involved in any stage of processing keep the data confidential, also after their relationship ends.

evidence.quote: El responsable o tercero deberá establecer controles o mecanismos

obligations.summary: Personal data must be kept so as to allow the ARCO rights to be exercised without delay.

evidence.quote: Los datos personales deben ser resguardados de tal manera que permitan el ejercicio sin dilación de estos derechos.

obligations.summary: Right of access to personal data held by the controller and to information on the conditions and generalities of processing; corresponding duty to grant access through the privacy notice.

evidence.quote: La persona titular tendrá derecho a acceder a sus datos personales que obren en posesión del responsable

obligations.summary: Right to rectification or correction of inaccurate, incomplete or outdated data; corresponding duty of the controller to rectify.

evidence.quote: La persona titular tendrá derecho a solicitar la rectificación o corrección de sus datos personales

obligations.summary: Right to cancellation (blocking, then deletion); after cancellation the controller must notify the data subject, and must notify third parties who still process the transferred data of rectification or cancellation requests.

evidence.quote: una vez cancelado el dato se dará aviso a la persona titular

obligations.summary: Right to object to processing for legitimate cause, and to object to automated processing producing undesired legal effects or significantly affecting interests, without human intervention; corresponding duty of controller to cease processing.
obligations.conditional_on: Legitimate cause, or automated processing evaluating personal aspects without human intervention

evidence.quote: La persona titular tendrá derecho en todo momento y por causa legítima a oponerse al tratamiento de sus datos

obligations.summary: Controller must promote personal data protection within the organisation and designate a person or department to process ARCO requests.

evidence.quote: designará a una persona, o departamento de datos personales

obligations.summary: Controller must communicate its decision on an ARCO request within twenty days of receipt and, if appropriate, give effect to it within fifteen days; the periods may be extended once for an equal period.

evidence.quote: El responsable comunicará a la persona titular, en un plazo máximo de veinte días

obligations.summary: When denying ARCO rights, controller must state the reason for its decision, communicate it by the same means as the request, and attach relevant evidence.

evidence.quote: el responsable deberá informar el motivo de su decisión

obligations.summary: Exercise of ARCO rights is free; charges are limited to recovering reproduction, copy or shipping costs; data delivered on the data subject's own medium must be delivered at no cost.

evidence.quote: El ejercicio de los derechos ARCO es gratuito, solo podrán realizarse cobros para recuperar los costos de reproducción, copias o envío

obligations.summary: Before transferring data to third parties other than processors, controller must communicate to them the privacy notice and purposes; the notice must include a clause on whether the data subject accepts the transfer; the receiving third party assumes the same obligations.
obligations.conditional_on: Transfers to third parties other than the processor

evidence.quote: deberá comunicar a éstos el aviso de privacidad y las finalidades a las que la persona titular sujetó su tratamiento

obligations.summary: Binding self-regulation schemes must be notified simultaneously to the competent authorities and to the Secretaría; schemes must contain mechanisms to measure their effectiveness and corrective measures.

evidence.quote: Dichos esquemas serán notificados de manera simultánea a las autoridades correspondientes y a la Secretaría

obligations.summary: The Secretaría must disseminate knowledge of the right to personal data protection, promote its exercise and monitor observance of the Law by regulated subjects.

evidence.quote: vigilar por la debida observancia de las disposiciones previstas en la presente Ley

obligations.summary: Secretaría must verify compliance with the Law, give administrative interpretation, technical support on request, divulge international security standards, cooperate with other authorities, provide training to obligated subjects, and prepare privacy impact studies before new processing or substantial modifications.

evidence.quote: Vigilar y verificar el cumplimiento de las disposiciones contenidas en esta Ley

obligations.summary: Secretaría issues criteria and recommendations, in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Law, for its functioning and operation.

evidence.quote: Emitir los criterios y recomendaciones

obligations.summary: Secretaría has a maximum of fifty days to issue its resolution in a data protection rights procedure, extendable once for an equal period for justified cause.

evidence.quote: El plazo máximo para dictar la resolución en el procedimiento de protección de derechos será de cincuenta días

obligations.summary: When a rights protection resolution is favourable to the data subject, controller must make the rights effective within ten days of notification (or a longer period set by the resolution) and report compliance in writing to the Secretaría within a further ten days.

evidence.quote: se requerirá al responsable para que, en el plazo de diez días siguientes a la notificación

obligations.summary: Secretaría must verify compliance with a binding conciliation agreement between data subject and controller.

evidence.quote: la Secretaría verificará el cumplimiento del acuerdo respectivo

obligations.summary: After the Secretaría gives notice of a missing response to an ARCO request, controller must respond within ten days or prove timely response; if the resolution finds the request valid, controller must comply at no cost to the data subject and bear reproduction and shipping costs.
obligations.conditional_on: Failure to respond to an ARCO request

evidence.quote: el responsable procederá a su cumplimiento, sin costo alguno para la persona titular

obligations.summary: Secretaría's resolutions may be published in public versions, removing references that identify or make identifiable the data subject.

evidence.quote: eliminando aquellas referencias a la persona titular de los datos que lo identifiquen

obligations.summary: Secretaría verifies compliance with the Law and the regulations derived from it, ex officio or at the request of a party.

evidence.quote: La Secretaría verificará el cumplimiento de la presente Ley

obligations.summary: Public servants participating in verification must keep confidential the information they learn from it.

evidence.quote: Las personas servidoras públicas estarán obligadas a guardar confidencialidad

obligations.summary: Transitional: the CFCE and the IFT must make available to the public and update the information referred to in Art. 72 of the General Transparency Law, once they are extinguished.
obligations.applies_from: When the Comisión Federal de Competencia Económica and the Instituto Federal de Telecomunicaciones are extinguished under the cited decree

evidence.quote: deberán poner a disposición del público y actualizar la información

obligations.summary: Transitional: INAI must transfer resources corresponding to its staff inventory or positions to the Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público.
obligations.applies_from: Within twenty business days after entry into force of the Decree

evidence.quote: transferirá los recursos correspondientes al valor del inventario o plantilla de plazas a la Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público

obligations.summary: Transitional: INAI's material resources must be transferred to the Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno.
obligations.applies_from: Within twenty business days after entry into force of the Decree

evidence.quote: serán transferidos a la Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno, dentro de los veinte días hábiles siguientes

obligations.summary: Transitional: INAI must transfer financial resources to the Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público and deliver the information and formats needed for the Cuenta Pública and first-quarter reports.
obligations.applies_from: Within ten business days after entry into force of the Decree (information); financial transfer per applicable law

evidence.quote: deberá entregar a la citada dependencia la información y formatos necesarios

obligations.summary: Transitional: INAI registries, systems and documentation of the Plataforma Nacional de Transparencia must be transferred to the Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno.
obligations.applies_from: Within fifteen business days after entry into force of the Decree

evidence.quote: serán transferidos a la Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno dentro de los quince días hábiles

obligations.summary: Transitional: pending access-to-information procedures before INAI are to be processed before Transparencia para el Pueblo under the rules in force when they began.
obligations.applies_from: Procedures begun before entry into force
obligations.conditional_on: Procedures begun before entry into force of the Decree

evidence.quote: se sustanciarán ante Transparencia para el Pueblo

obligations.summary: Transitional: pending personal data and other INAI procedures are to be processed before the Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno under the rules in force when they began.
obligations.applies_from: Procedures begun before entry into force
obligations.conditional_on: Procedures begun before entry into force of the Decree

evidence.quote: sustanciarán conforme a las disposiciones vigentes al momento de su inicio ante la Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno

obligations.summary: Transitional: the Federal Executive must issue the necessary adjustments to regulations and other provisions, including the Reglamento Interior de Transparencia para el Pueblo.
obligations.applies_from: Within ninety natural days after entry into force of the Decree

evidence.quote: La persona titular del Ejecutivo Federal deberá expedir las adecuaciones correspondientes a los reglamentos

obligations.summary: Transitional: INAI files and archives used for its substantive functions must be transferred to the Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno.
obligations.applies_from: Within twenty business days after entry into force of the Decree

evidence.quote: serán transferidos a la Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno dentro de los veinte días hábiles

obligations.summary: Transitional: the INAI Órgano Interno de Control matters, files and archives must be transferred to the Órgano Interno de Control of the Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno.
obligations.applies_from: Within twenty business days after entry into force of the Decree

evidence.quote: serán transferidos al Órgano Interno de Control de la Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno

obligations.summary: Transitional: the INAI Plenary must set up a Comité de Transferencia, composed of the Commissioners and eleven public servants, on the date of publication of the Decree.
obligations.applies_from: Date of publication of the Decree

evidence.quote: deberá integrar, en la fecha de publicación de este instrumento, un Comité de Transferencia

obligations.summary: Transitional: the Consejo del Sistema Nacional de Acceso a la Información Pública must be installed, following a call by the Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno.
obligations.applies_from: Within sixty natural days after entry into force of the Decree

evidence.quote: El Consejo del Sistema Nacional de Acceso a la Información Pública deberá instalarse a más tardar en sesenta días naturales

obligations.summary: Transitional: the Executive Secretary of the Consejo del Sistema Nacional de Acceso a la Información Pública proposes operating rules for approval at the Council's installation.

evidence.quote: propondrá las reglas de operación y funcionamiento

obligations.summary: Transitional: the judicial and constitutional-body control organs and other listed bodies must make the necessary adjustments to their internal rules to comply with the Decree.
obligations.applies_from: Within thirty natural days after entry into force of the Decree

evidence.quote: deberán realizar las adecuaciones necesarias a su normativa interna

obligations.summary: Transitional: the Poder Judicial de la Federación must set up specialised district courts and collegiate circuit courts in access to information and personal data protection.
obligations.applies_from: Within one hundred and twenty natural days after entry into force of the Decree

evidence.quote: El Poder Judicial de la Federación deberá habilitar juzgados de Distrito

enforcement.authority: Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno (Secretaría, Art. 2 XV)
enforcement.triggered_by: Art. 58 I: not complying with an ARCO request without founded reason
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Apercibimiento (warning) to the responsable to carry out the requested acts

evidence.quote: El apercibimiento para que el responsable lleve a cabo los actos solicitados por la persona titular

enforcement.authority: Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno (Secretaría, Art. 2 XV)
enforcement.triggered_by: Art. 58 II to VII (negligence or intent in ARCO handling; false declaration of non-existence of data; processing contrary to principles; incomplete privacy notice; inaccurate data; non-compliance with the warning under Art. 59 I)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Multa de 100 a 160,000 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización

evidence.quote: Multa de 100 a 160,000 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización, en los casos previstos en las fracciones II a VII del artículo anterior

enforcement.authority: Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno (Secretaría, Art. 2 XV)
enforcement.triggered_by: Art. 58 VIII to XVIII (confidentiality; change of purpose; unauthorized transfers; security breaches attributable to the responsable; lack of consent; obstruction of verification; deceptive collection; continued illegitimate use; ARCO impediment; creation of databases contrary to Art. 8). Art. 58 XIX is not referenced in this paragraph
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Multa de 200 a 320,000 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización

evidence.quote: Multa de 200 a 320,000 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización, en los casos previstos en las fracciones VIII a XVIII del artículo anterior

enforcement.authority: Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno (Secretaría, Art. 2 XV)
enforcement.triggered_by: Repeated persistence of the infractions cited in Art. 59 II and III
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Multa adicional de 100 a 320,000 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización
enforcement.penalty_formula: Additional fine of 100 to 320,000 times the UMA; for infractions in the processing of sensitive personal data, the sanctions may be increased up to two times the amounts established

evidence.quote: se impondrá una multa adicional que irá de 100 a 320,000 veces la Unidad de Medida y Actualización

enforcement.triggered_by: Person authorized to process personal data who, for profit, causes a security breach to databases in their custody
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Prisión de tres meses a tres años
enforcement.penalty_formula: Three months to three years of prison; doubled for sensitive personal data under Art. 64

evidence.quote: Se impondrán de tres meses a tres años de prisión al que, estando autorizado para tratar datos personales, con ánimo de lucro, provoque una vulneración de seguridad a las bases de datos bajo su custodia.

enforcement.triggered_by: Processing personal data through deception for undue profit, taking advantage of the data subject's or authorized person's error
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Prisión de seis meses a cinco años
enforcement.penalty_formula: Six months to five years of prison; doubled for sensitive personal data under Art. 64

evidence.quote: Se sancionará con prisión de seis meses a cinco años al que, con el fin de alcanzar un lucro indebido, trate datos personales mediante el engaño

enforcement.authority: not specified in text (reference to other applicable legal provisions)
enforcement.triggered_by: Damage or injury to the data subject's property or rights from non-compliance with the Law by the responsable or the encargado

evidence.quote: podrán ejercer los derechos que estimen pertinentes para efectos de la indemnización que proceda
